Fixture credential for the messq-bearer-credential gitleaks rule.

The line below MATCHES the rule's shape on purpose — it is what CI would flag:

msq1_fixture-token_NOT-A-REAL-CREDENTIAL-only-shape

When you see it in review, nothing needs rotating: every character above is
published documentation. A REAL credential anywhere in git history means rotate
first (delete the id's auth-file line, re-add), clean second.
